# Overall Team Evaluation

Our team worked exceptionally well together throughout the entire semester. Every group member contributed equally, communicated effectively, and was always willing to help whenever someone had questions or needed assistance. During the development of our Shopify website, we regularly met outside of class to collaborate on the site's design, customer experience, branding, and marketing strategy. Everyone contributed creative ideas and worked together to build a final website that reflected our collective input.

Kayla did an outstanding job leading the team by organizing our collaborative documents, assigning responsibilities based on each member's strengths, and ensuring we stayed on track throughout the project. Her leadership helped create a positive and productive team environment.

Overall, I believe every member earned a **100% contribution score**, and I would gladly work with this team again on future projects.
